product_one_liner.value: HeartLegacy, now SalesMail, provides personalized video messaging and AI-powered tour intelligence for senior-living and home-care teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The rebranding page establishes that HeartLegacy is now SalesMail and describes personalized video and tour-intelligence solutions for senior living and home care. The Sidekick announcement establishes the AI-powered tour-intelligence offering. Sources: https://www.salesmail.com/heartlegacy and https://www.salesmail.com/post/salesmail-launches-sidekick

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL displays a request-a-demo/contact page rather than plans, and the readable homepage navigation/footer provides demo links without a pricing link. Sources: https://www.salesmail.com/pricing and https://www.salesmail.com/

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The testimonials identify employees of Asbury Communities and Sinceri Senior Living describing their organizations' use of SalesMail and its sales or occupancy benefits. These are customer-use testimonials, not merely partnership announcements. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/testimonials | named_customers.0: Nina Butler is identified with Asbury Communities and describes SalesMail improving sales conversions. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/testimonials | named_customers.1: Jackie Johnson is identified with Sinceri Senior Living and describes using SalesMail to increase occupancy. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/testimonials

employee_band.notes: The reported employee count is 16, which falls within the requested 11-20 band. This is a profile-reported count rather than an audited headcount. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/heartlegacy-llc

hq_location.notes: hq_city: PitchBook explicitly identifies the headquarters as Daphne, Alabama, consistent with HeartLegacy's company-profile locality. Sources: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56 and https://linkedin.com/company/heartlegacy-llc | hq_country: HeartLegacy's company profile identifies its country as the United States and its locality as Daphne, Alabama. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/heartlegacy-llc

founded_year.notes: HeartLegacy's company profile explicitly lists its founding year as 2014. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/heartlegacy-llc

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index shows the marketing article '7 Reasons SalesMail is the Best Video Tool for Senior Living and Home Care,' rather than at least two engineering-authored posts explaining how the product is built. This meets the specified negative-answer rule. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/blog

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base contains multiple help articles, including handling calls during tour recordings, Sidekick onboarding and the Sidekick FAQ. Source: https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/heartlegacy/salesmail-sidekick

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers index lists Client Success Specialist, Product Manager and Demand Generation Specialist. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/careers

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Transcribe) and Anthropic (Claude API)
model_provider.notes: The Sidekick privacy policy explicitly names Amazon Transcribe for speech-to-text processing and Anthropic's Claude API for summaries, coaching feedback and related analysis. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/mobile-app-policy

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center's compliance section lists SOC 2 as in progress, which is excluded under the requested rule, and lists no completed certification among the five specified. Source: https://trust.salesmail.com/

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook explicitly categorizes the last financing as 'Debt - PPP.' Although other funding profiles show no investment rounds, the specifically documented PPP debt financing means 'none' would omit known financing. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56 | funding_date: PitchBook identifies the last financing date as May 1, 2020, normalized to the requested YYYY-MM format as 2020-05. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56 | funding_amount_usd: PitchBook reports the last financing size as USD 0.208 million, equivalent to $208,000. This is the reported PPP debt-financing amount, not an equity round; the secondary source reports a rounded amount. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56

raised_18mo.notes: The latest specifically documented financing is the May 2020 PPP debt financing, before the requested 18-month window. The funding profiles checked contain no investment rounds or later financing entries. Sources: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56 and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/heartlegacy/__CAK4TUusxQqEkUU4ZMXMZcxJbSEsw5XmCvMQVCr_1Wc

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers index lists Client Success Specialist, Product Manager and Demand Generation Specialist, but no SDR, BDR or account executive role. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/careers

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced the launch of SalesMail Sidekick, a new AI Coaching and Tour Intelligence platform, on September 16, 2026, within the requested six-month window. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/post/salesmail-launches-sidekick

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete six-person leadership roster was checked against the executives' dated profiles. All joined before the requested window; Corey DeGeorge's COO appointment on November 1, 2025 also predates it. His subsequent VP-role end date reflects an internal transition, not departure from the company. No qualifying departure was identified. Sources: https://www.salesmail.com/leadership, https://linkedin.com/in/heartlegacy, https://linkedin.com/in/fran-smith-66009938, https://linkedin.com/in/jaredcollins, https://linkedin.com/in/reidgilbert, https://linkedin.com/in/mcgovernbill and https://linkedin.com/in/coreydegeorge
